newsitem.title: BELGIUM: NATO's Joulwan receives alliance medal.
newsitem.headline: NATO's Joulwan receives alliance medal.

text.p: NATO's outgoing commander in Europe, General George Joulwan, was awarded the NATO medal on Thursday for his services to the alliance.
Joulwan, who retires in July after 40 years service in the military, was presented with the honour by Secretary-General Javier Solana at a short ceremony at the alliance's Brussels headquarters.
Solana praised Joulwan, overall commander of NATO's peace mission in Bosnia, as an "outstanding military commander".
"Your contributions to peace in Bosnia, the Partnership for Peace and the adaptations of the alliance to new roles and missions will be enduring legacies," Solana said.
Joulwan, 57, said he was honoured to have served the alliance, but said the mission would continue.
"It is one team, one mission and one NATO, and the mission continues," he said.
